description: This file contains API service functions for fetching and running TR471 network test configurations, including mock data for development environment, and handles authentication and response processing.

methods.name: getTR471Config
methods.description: Fetches TR471 configuration data, either from mock data in development or via API call in production, with authentication handling.

methods.name: runTR471Test
methods.description: Runs a TR471 network test with given configuration, returning results or mock data in development, with authentication handling.
